lead: # Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the one home-dir resolver.
# Shared CLI arg parsing, so this store's flags behave like every other store's.
# Embeds the packaged corpus (src-tauri/data/atlas/**) at compile time so a fresh atlas.db seeds on
# first open — the same pattern skilldb uses for src-tauri/data/skills.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches skilldb / plandb) for cross-platform reliability.
# `hooks` is pure Rust (the feature is literally `hooks = []`, no extra C), and it is here for a TEST:
# `every_seed_is_one_transaction` installs a commit hook to COUNT commits, which is what pins the seed
# to a single transaction. Counting is the only way to state that invariant as something other than a
# timing assertion — the unbatched seed cost 0.19s alone and 139s under a loaded workspace run, so a
# wall-clock threshold would be measuring the machine rather than the code.
# The row overlay that puts atlas.db on lanes (the-relational-stores-are-laned).
# build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
